- `persona.py`: play and bidding styles with knowledge (0–80%), disclosure (usually 75% of knowledge) and the correlation between dimensions (drawn per partnership). `draw_partnership` correlates each latent draw 0.5 with the partner's; `seats()` gives an independent partnership a side. `public(identifier)` is what anyone may know. Cards: the derived 1NT rebid range under a 1NT opening from 13 or 14 (G9-B10 item 4)

When a card does not state its 1NT rebid range, it was derived as the range above the 1NT opening whenever the
opening started at 14 or lower: 17-17 for a 14-16 notrump, empty for 14-17. Now a 1NT opening from 13 or 14 with two
points or more below it gives the balanced minimum under it, as a strong notrump does: (11, 13) for 14-16 with 11-point
openings, (12, 13) for 14-17 with 12. Weak notrumps keep the range above.
